assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Production environment background for PAPERSUN, a poetic original story staged in miniature cut-paper theater. Use the attached reference ONLY for tactile fibrous paper material, layered physical construction, navy/cream/cornflower palette and cinematic warm right sidelight. Compose an entirely new scene. Every object is handmade thick cotton cardstock, irregular cut and deckle edges, watercolor grain, visibly separated planes and real shallow contact shadows, never glossy 3D plastic, never origami. Wide 16:10 landscape image. Keep the left 38 percent and upper-left exceptionally quiet dark navy paper for later real HTML reading text. NO text, glyphs, letters, numbers, logos, no UI. NO sun, moon, golden pieces or person. Scene: Mira's intimate attic lantern repair room. Upper-right sloping rafters and a small blue paper window. Desk occupies right half and lower third, with one single small amber lantern glowing on right, fine sewing needle and small scissors, coil of red linen thread, tiny blank cream paper note, careful scuffs and paper fibers. Desk surface has ample uncluttered space for later live story objects. Cozy warm ivory/blue paper architecture, a straight-on small theater stage, strong dimensional depth with at least five physical paper planes. A refined adult fairy-tale aesthetic, calm and beautifully composed.
assets.review: Selected. Cohesive textured paper miniature with one amber lantern, empty workshop desk region, red thread, scissors, needle and a blank note. No character, golden fragment, sun, moon or text. Generous left title safety.
